mission: REPMILE FIVE-ZONE HEART RATE INTELLIGENCE V1 (V1HR5), Founder request of 2026-11-25 (audits/v1-five-zone-heart-rate-2026-11-25/FOUNDER_REQUEST.md)
reason: Founder decision: V1 has five heart-rate zones truly computed by CoachingCore, not a five-segment drawing of the three; the three physiological domains are kept.

method.summary: Z1-Z5 as fixed per-mille fractions of one reference maximum (720/800/870/920), nested in the approved LOW/MODERATE/HIGH domains (Z1+Z2, Z3, Z4+Z5); reference = a lab maximum (declared running test, chest strap or ECG, RPE >= 8, tolerated, <= 182 days) else the approved chest-strap observed maximum (Q6(b)); REFERENCE_CONFLICT when the strap reads > 5 bpm above the lab; LOW confidence; effort governs every session, heart rate never primary, a sustained Z4+ reading may suggest slowing in easy running only; time in zone UNAVAILABLE (no series in V1).
method.boundary: V1X-RUN-HR-FIVE-ZONE, enabled by SSCTR-HR5-RECHECK-r1 (APPROVE_WITH_CONDITIONS, SUPPORTED_WITH_LIMITS), with V1X-RUN-CAPACITY and V1X-RUN-HR

contracts.engine: additive: runCalibration.heartRateFiveZones (with per-session roles in heartRateFiveZones.sessions); every other key byte-identical
contracts.shared: no shared contract changed (ios/Packages/IntegrationContracts, A/B handoffs, the parallel contract, A/B worktrees untouched); Swift delta in the mission copy of CHG-UI-1 (audits/v1-five-zone-heart-rate-2026-11-25/proposals/CoachingPresentation)

validates: This amendment validates, for synthetic athletes only: the five-zone reading and per-session heart-rate roles of CoachingCore at the bound bytes; that every other engine output is byte-identical to the original freeze's (additive); that Node, macOS JavaScriptCore and iPhone JavaScriptCore agree on it; and its persistence and integrity through the integration boundary. It does not validate real athletes, HealthKit, heart-rate series, any UI, or the application; REAL_ATHLETE_READY stays NO.
